description: This file defines the ConnectionOpened event class in a Java project, representing an event emitted after a network connection is opened. It includes factory methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, as well as serialization support.

classes.name: ConnectionOpened
classes.description: An immutable class representing a 'connection opened' event in the connectivity system, capable of serialization/deserialization and factory creation.

methods.name: ConnectionOpened.of
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionOpened event from a ConnectionId and headers, with optional timestamp.

methods.name: ConnectionOpened.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionOpened event from a JSON string or object and headers.

methods.name: ConnectionOpened.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ConnectionOpened with specified headers.
